‘1971 Shei Shob Din’ to showcase first song today
2023-07-20T10:39:59+06:00 | Arts & Entertainment Desk
https://www.thedailystar.net/entertainment/tv-film/news/1971-shei-shob-din-showcase-first-song-today-3373941

Get ready to experience the magical flavour of 70's with "Jaccho Kothai" from Hridi Huq directorial movie "1971 Shei Shob Din."

The song will be released on Bongo's YouTube Channel at 7 pm today.

The first look of the song features Sanjida Preeti and Shajal Noor.

Sanjida Preeti looked stunning in a yellow saree with long braided hair, while Shajal looked dashing in a newsboy cap and striped jumper that exuded a colourful throwback vibe.

"1971 Shei Shob Din" revolves around a family's experiences during 1971, providing a poignant portrayal of the era.

Apart from directing, Hridi Haq herself features in "1971 Shei Shob Din", alongside a talented ensemble cast comprised of Mamunur Rashid, Jayanta Chattopadhyay, Munmun Ahmed, Shilpi Sharkar Apu, Ferdous, Tareen, Litu Anam, Saju Khadem, Sanjida Preeti, and many more. Notably, Litu Anam makes a remarkable comeback to cinema with this film, after a hiatus of 15 years.

Hridi Haq’s ‘1971 Shei Shob Din’ release date announced

In the movie, Ferdous, Litu Anam, and Shajal deliver compelling performances, portraying the roles of three brothers actively engaged in the Liberation War.
